run_slurm_pipeline: run a datatrove SlurmPipelineExecutor to download and process MC4 dataset from HuggingFace
create_jsonl_reader: create a JsonlReader that reads from a HuggingFace dataset with a glob pattern and custom adapter
create_jsonl_writer: create a JsonlWriter that outputs processed data to language-partitioned JSONL files
build_data_adapter: build a custom adapter function to transform raw data into datatrove Document format with text, id, media and metadata
configure_slurm_executor: configure a SlurmPipelineExecutor with tasks, memory, logging, partition and time settings
